deviations.what: Fifteen CheckBoxes across all states (selected, partiallySelected, required, enabled, valueState Warning/Error/Information, wrapping) plus a SimpleForm with GridData-laid-out CheckBoxes, reproduced 1:1.
CheckBox.required (@since 1.121, the 'Required option' CheckBox) is used 1:1. Newer than UI5 1.71; declared per the property-171 policy, so the app needs UI5 >= 1.121 to render the required state.
